propositions: Real CLI execution must traverse a single validated registry route and selected lazy handler instead of parallel intercept/dispatch ladders and policy frozensets.
The top-level router must pass original command remainder unchanged to the selected handler, which parses exactly once via S2's shared argparse factory without route-level option grammar.
Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policy (none/init_only/full), and conditional selectors must match pre-cutover behavior for all routes including no-auto-mount cases.
Handler execution must preserve confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, tokens after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation through a closed typed adapter-kind set.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden bridge-status must execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown.
